title: Research: four transfers cannot realize universal two-connector masks
body:
PR1438 leaves open whether four paid one-way transfers can realize all 31 nonzero five-source masks with two arbitrary dirty connectors and two calls per active operator. This package answers **no**: even with freely chosen source ports, four transfers cover at most 31 masks including zero. **At least six transfers are necessary in the 72-call family.** Six-transfer sufficiency and extra-call schedules remain open.

The new source-port partition argument limits mixed-mask projections; its exceptional cases reduce to Ross Richardson's existing 945-pairing boundary, independently recomputed here. The second row, complete port-specific children, transfers, admission, preparation and dispatch are explicitly priced. A scalar-bit transfer implementation also accounts for its private bit, head movement and restoration. No selected supplier, frontier or kappa changes.

Only `research/two-connector-four-transfer-obstruction/` is added. The [proof and scope](https://github.com/bitplane/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5431fba4a80e30925e0c2b2c161b9c68bbac1c17/research/two-connector-four-transfer-obstruction/README.md) include exact source pins, an achieved 31-mask fixture, the complete conditional cost comparison and open next questions.

Validation passed on CPython 3.12.3 and an isolated read-only CPython 3.14.4 replay with `-I -O -B`:

- Two old-path enumerations, all 37,449 phase tuples and two complete small-skeleton checks covering 26,070 candidates.
- Free noncommutative forward/inverse identities; 880 dense basis columns in each direction, with arbitrary dirt and noncommuting maps.
- All 14 single-operation omissions rejected, plus wrong-port/dirt controls; 570 transfer-backend tape columns in each direction.
- Registered replay, eight package controls, exact receipt comparison, source pins, unchanged replay bytes and clean patch application.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-connector-four-transfer-obstruction
```

Canonical receipt: `634f52fbc426328115666a74282b4bd71acb3de9600cd125c33524754dc9991e`. No full selected cold replay, supplier admission, proof-assistant result or hosted CI completion is claimed.

Credit **woklerx PR1438** at `a61170c97c9ea2c396f6d76a953b0cf74a455cdd` for the question, prior four-transfer lower bound and two-source fixture; **Ross Richardson PR943/934** and the retained commutator/fanout lineage for the old boundary. **Cinna Davis's Discussion1412** separately fixes all source calls to one root and announces an eight-transfer result; that provisional claim is retained and distinguished, not assumed.

Single random assignment `03de982dd845f2b40aeaaef2a1eecd7c`, recursive interfaces, refined `connector-alphabet-change`; [coordination and finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1486). Final overlap refresh fully paginated 750 open PRs and 183 Discussion records without warnings. Base `4040a0f46d67b41c36a472a7cd4af791fd4c36cc`; upstream `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6` changed 397 files but none of the pinned mathematical inputs, selected provenance or applicable instructions.

Prepared by **Gareth Davidson (@bitplane)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**. Apache-2.0; predecessor bytes/notices retained. No independent human review is asserted.
